name: locternos
description: Aternos alternative, self-hosted control panel for managing local Minecraft servers effortlessly.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @locternos/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @locternos/shared" "npm run dev -w @locternos/backend" "npm run dev -w @locternos/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @locternos/shared && npm run build -w @locternos/backend && npm run build -w @locternos/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @locternos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @locternos/backend && npm run typecheck -w @locternos/frontend
